items.title: Spotify's Memberships program for podcasts is here to compete with Patreon

items.lede: Spotify is enabling podcast creators to earn more money through the platform by providing their fans with a way to pay to access exclusive content. First announced in May, the new Memberships subscription feature is starting to roll out in 34 regions today, allowing podcasters to offer perks including additional content, early access, bonus episodes, […]
items.title: Spotify’s new podcast memberships let you pay for extra perks

items.lede: Spotify's new paid memberships let podcasters offer fans exclusive perks, including ad-free listening, early access, and bonus content, while keeping 90% of the revenue.
items.title: Spotify launches paid podcast memberships with perks beyond bonus content
